name: Platinum mounting
summary: A frame of platinum, a metal strong enough to hold stones with thin lines, so that the metal nearly disappears.
how: Draw the frame with thin, open lines.
Saw and file the platinum and join the parts with a torch.
Set each stone in fine claws and add a milgrained edge.

origin.note: Paris jewellers mount diamonds in platinum, which is stronger than silver and does not tarnish.

adoptions.via: Cartier and other Paris houses make lace-like garlands and tiaras in platinum and diamond.
Platinum frames hold baguette diamonds and onyx in hard, flat geometric jewels.
